steps.name: adb-readiness
steps.command:
set -u
echo '=== TRACKER LOCAL/ADB READINESS ==='
printf 'repo='; git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'head='; git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- git status --short ---'
git status --short 2>/dev/null || true
echo '--- adb binary ---'
if command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  command -v adb
  adb version || true
  echo '--- adb devices -l ---'
  adb devices -l || true
  DEVICE_LINES=$(adb devices 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' || true)
  if [ -z "$DEVICE_LINES" ]; then
    echo 'ADB_FLOW_STATUS=READY_NO_DEVICE'
  elif printf '%s\n' "$DEVICE_LINES" | grep -q $'\tunauthorized'; then
    echo 'ADB_FLOW_STATUS=DEVICE_UNAUTHORIZED'
  elif printf '%s\n' "$DEVICE_LINES" | grep -q $'\tdevice'; then
    echo 'ADB_FLOW_STATUS=DEVICE_CONNECTED'
  else
    echo 'ADB_FLOW_STATUS=DEVICE_OTHER_STATE'
  fi
else
  echo 'adb not found in PATH'
  echo 'ADB_FLOW_STATUS=ADB_MISSING'
fi
exit 0
